events.name: Leonid & Friends
events.info: Leonid & FriendsLeonid united by a shared passion for celebrating this iconic era of music.Originally conceived as a studio project in Moscow, Leonid reviving the sound, spirit, and joy of a generation with unmatched musicianship and heart.In concert, Leonid 25 or 6 to 4, Make Me Smile, Does Anybody Really Know What Time It Is?, Feelin Stronger Every Day, Beginnings, Questions 67 and Hard to Say Im Sorry / Get Away, along with select surprises from an ever-expanding repertoire that includes Earth, Wind 70s favorites.Each performance is more than a tribute concertits a joyous celebration of the music that defined an era.__________________________________________CLUB POLICIESShow 6:30pm & 9pmDoors 5pm & 8:30pmSeating is First Come, First Served Per Section$20 Minimum Per PersonFull Bar & Dinner Menu AvailableNO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES.Tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime.Please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time.When all available Bar Seats are occupied, the remaining Bar Area is standing room only. Table Seating is All Ages, Bar Area is 21+.IMPORTANT NOTE: We are NOT affiliated with ANY third-party ticket sellers! Tickets purchased directly through our official website or TicketWeb are the ONLY authorized sources.GROUP RESERVATIONS: Groups of 6 or more that want to sit together must purchase a group package at events@bluenotehawaii.com.PARKING: Validated parking available at OUTRIGGER Paradise. Entrance located on Kuhio Ave. $6 for up to 4 hours of parking.
events.pleaseNote: For parties of 6 or more please call us at 808-777-4898 to book! We do not offer any refunds, exchanges, or transfers on any ticket purchases. All sales are final. We do not have any liability or influence on tickets purchased through a ticket reselling or 3rd party site. Official ticket purchases are run through TicketWeb.com only.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: For Advance Ticket Sales Main Box Office (Arena) Hours: ** Monday - Saturday, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM **Closed on Sunday and all Holidays unless there is a scheduled event for that day and only that event will be sold. For Day of Event Ticket Sales Main Box Office Hours: Closed on Sundays, and all Holidays unless there is a scheduled event for that day.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call may be picked up at any window at any time that the box office is open. Customers do not need to wait until the night of the show.

venues.parkingDetail: Cost: Event Parking: Before 5PM: $6.00 After 5PM: $7.00 In/Out Pass: $8.00 (In/Out Good Only For Day of Purchase @ Parking Booth) NON-EVENT PARKING (DAILY): $6.00 VIP Parking available for select events is $23.00 Elite VIP Parking: VIP Parking is open for ticket holders only, subject to availability Selected Blaisdell Arena events, please enter off of Ward Ave. South (Makai) of Box Office Selected Concert Hall and Exhibition events, please enter off of Ward Ave. between Exhibition Hall and Concert Hall Note: No left turn permitted on Ward Ave. into driveways Hours of Operation is 1 1/2 hours prior to event until end of event time Box Office Parking: Box Office Parking is open for ticket buyers only. Parking for the patrons of the Box Office is free. If Box Office Parking is full, ticket buyers may enter through the King Street Gate. The ticket buyers will be refunded the parking fee after they validate their ticket at the Box Office. King Street Entrance: This is the main entrance to the Blaisdell Parking Lot. The gate opens at 5:30 a.m., Monday through Saturday. The gate closes at 6:00 p.m. on all evenings with no event scheduled. The gate closes 45 minutes after the last event is completed. On Sundays and Holidays, gate operation is determined by events. Kapiolani Entrance: This entrance is closed when there are no events scheduled. Only cardholders can access this gate when it is unattended. Signs are posted to direct non-card holders to the King Street entrance. This gate will also be open two hours prior to the opening of all major events scheduled in the central areas and will remain open until the completion of the last event. Hours of Operation: Event Days (Mon thru Fri) 5:30am to the end of night (event night) Event Days (Weekends & Holidays) 2 Hours prior to start of event to the end of night Parking Booths close 45 minutes prior to end of last event.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: To better accommodate your needs, Neal S Blaisdell Concert Hall has requested that all special seating accommodations be solicited only through their representatives. Please contact a Neal S Blaisdell Concert Hall representative for further help with your ticket purchase.* Advance ticket purchase may be required. The Neal S Blaisdell Concert Hall allows a maximum of 1 companion for every wheel chair space. Additional companions may be purchased based upon availability in the nearest section. * Box office information is subject to change.
